description:
Jojo is Japanese you can hear, tap, and keep.

Open the app and a short clip starts. Someone is ordering at a convenience store, greeting a classmate, or talking the way people actually talk. The line on screen is the line they said. Tap a word the moment you hear it. Jojo shows the reading, what it means in that sentence, and a place to save it. Later, the same sentence comes back on a review card, so the word is never a bare flashcard on its own.

HOW A CLIP TEACHES

Every clip in the study feed carries a transcript taken from that video. Japanese is split into words, with readings for kanji, an English line, and a sense of how hard the clip is. As the audio moves, the word being spoken is the one in front of you.

Tap it and the video stays behind the card. You get the dictionary senses, then a short note on what the word means right here, plus one example. Save it and that note stays attached. When the card returns, you still see the line it came from. Mark it good and Jojo treats it as known. You can also save a whole line when the sentence is the thing you want to keep.

FOR YOU

For You is a vertical feed of short Japanese clips. Swipe when you have had enough. Stay when a clip fits. Jojo notices. Clips you finish and clips you love pull more of that kind of Japanese forward. Clips you skip fall back. A favorite and a channel you follow stay close. What you watch matters more the longer you stay.

A beginner hears clearer, slower Japanese. Stay with harder clips and the feed leans that way too. The daily goal is a few minutes, not a pile of chores.

Leave the app and the Dynamic Island can keep the last line up: the spoken word in the small island, and the reading, the Japanese, and the English when you expand it or look at the lock screen. Tap it to return to the feed. Leave For You and the island goes away.

YOUR WORDS

Vocab shows how many words you know, how many are due, and a review button that names the next card. Due cards come first. If nothing is due, Jojo offers a short pass through words you are still learning. A known word is a green check. The rest show how often you have met them, the reading, and a short gloss.

Search looks through clips and words together. A result shows the still, the line, where it is from, and a level. Look up a word, a difficulty, a grammar point, or a topic, then drop into that moment.

YOUR LOOK

Jojo has three colors, each in light and dark: Sakura, Lavender, and Orange. Pick one before you start, and change it anytime in Profile. Text can sit flat, or carry a soft glow, a brighter glow, or a liquid edge. Study screens stay easy to read. The feed and Profile wear the look you chose.

A home-screen widget carries your streak, the minutes left today, and how many cards are due. The medium size shows the next word with its reading above the English. Tap it to review, or to open the feed when nothing is due.

WHO IT IS FOR

Jojo is for people who want Japanese from speech, not only from lists. Beginners can start with greetings, shop talk, and slow dialogue. Later you can sit with cooking, variety, and faster talk. If drills never quite prepared you for a real voice, this is the other half of practice: ears first, cards second.

One finished clip and one saved word beat a plan you never open.


## *SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION*

All features described above require an active Jojo subscription.

Yearly and monthly subscription plans are available. The yearly plan includes a 3-day free trial for new subscribers. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time through your Apple Account settings.
